若 X 有分解为两个真闭子集的并，则由 X 连通与 Z 不可约可推出一个分解与假设矛盾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement concerns the irreducibility of a space from which a closed irreducible subset has been removed, under the hypothesis that the whole space is connected (author lemma at source lines 1439-1444, label lemma-remove-irreducible-connected). The author's own proof at source lines 1446-1454 follows it immediately and is its proof, arguing from a hypothetical decomposition of the ambient space and using the irreducibility of the closed subset and connectedness to contradict the hypotheses on the complement (proof lines 1446-1453). The case analysis on a decomposition is the content. H2.
